entry.title: The Three Faisal Qureshis of Pakistani Media
entry.summary: Pakistan's media is filled with stars, but have you ever noticed how many share the same name? It might be…
entry.content:
Pakistan's media is filled with stars, but have you ever noticed how many share the same name?

It might be hard to believe, but there are at least three Faisal Qureshis in Pakistani media. And people often confuse one with the other.

The three of us are good friends and have even appeared on TV together more than once.

Here’s a bit about all three of us, to help you keep us straight.

Faysal Quraishi - Actor/Host

The actor, producer, and show host, Faysal is widely recognized for his acting prowess in numerous drama serials and films. You can connect with him at [Instagram] [X] [Facebook][Threads]

Faisal Qureshi - Film-maker/Actor

Faisal is a versatile television personality, working as a television actor, director, producer, screenwriter, filmmaker, and humorist. You can connect with him at [Facebook] [Instagram].

Faisal Qureshi - Host/Journalist/Broadcaster

This is me. I’ve hosted TV shows in Pakistan on various channels. My main focus used to be social issues. But somehow, I also started doing current affairs shows.

That makes me a pseudo-journalist.

I say "pseudo" because I never went to journalism school. It's not my full-time career. I only did it part-time.

You can connect with me here.

entry.title: Everything you wanted to know about me, but...
entry.summary: Welcome to my world—a nod to the journey, not the destination. Life has been a mix of highs and lows,…
entry.content:
Welcome to my world—a nod to the journey, not the destination. Life has been a mix of highs and lows, successes and failures, lessons learned along the way. In the end, all experiences were part of the process that shaped who I am today.

Professionally, I’ve worn many hats, adapting as times changed. Personally and spiritually, I’ve grown in ways I never imagined, always seeking deeper meaning. Labels don’t define me—they’re just markers on a much larger map.

Let me take you through the many facets that make up who I am today.

🔌 The Electrical Engineer

My journey began with a degree in Electrical Engineering, which instilled in me a structured, analytical approach to problem-solving. Although I never worked as an Electrical Engineer, that foundational training profoundly shaped how I think.

Even today, I break down complex systems into understandable components—whether it’s software or an abstract idea. This skill has served me well across all areas of life.

💾 The Self-Taught Technology Entrepreneur

I ran a software company for nearly 20 years in Pakistan, back when hardly anyone was doing it. Without fancy degrees, I simply learned by doing and figured things out as I went along.

This hands-on experience taught me resilience and adaptability—qualities that have been invaluable throughout my career.

📺 TV Anchor

I had the privilege of being among Pakistan’s first generation of TV talk show hosts, appearing on screen for nearly two decades before television became the crowded space it is today.

I hosted various shows in both English and Urdu. My programs focused on thoughtful analysis of current affairs, nuanced discussions of social issues, and giving voice to perspectives often overlooked.

☪️ The Muslim By Conscious Choice

Though I was born into Islam, that’s not why I’m a Muslim today. My faith is the result of conscious exploration.

I took a journey through all major religious traditions. After this exploration, I came to see Islam as the divine culmination—it represents the final and complete message from God.

Islam is the foundation of my spiritual life. At the same time, I continue to explore other faiths, philosophies, and ways of life. I seek to understand what connects us all.

Some Westerners and Islamophobes may feel troubled by this belief. My intention isn’t to provoke. Instead, I hope they’ll take the time to truly understand Islam beyond stereotypes.

🕊️ The Purposeful Retiree

I retired after an important realization: money is merely a tool for living, not the purpose of living.

Once I reached financial independence, everything changed. I gained the freedom to choose how to spend my time based on what fulfills me instead of what pays me.

Admittedly, this freedom came later than I’d hoped. But now, each day brings the luxury of pursuing what truly matters.

♻️ The Constant Reinventor

Change has been one constant in my life. I’ve never been content staying in just one role or identity.

For instance, I transitioned from being an engineer to an entrepreneur, a broadcaster to a writer, and a seeker to a teacher. Each evolution builds upon what came before while opening new dimensions of understanding.

Instead of viewing transformation as disruption, I see it as natural growth.

📚 The Eternal Student

The idea of a bodhisattva—a seeker who strives for enlightenment not just for themselves but to help others—resonates deeply with me. It fuels my unquenchable thirst for knowledge.

Learning, for me, is about more than acquiring knowledge—it’s about transformation. First, I focus on growing myself. Then, through compassion, I aim to share what I’ve learned with others who are searching for wisdom.

This cycle of growth and giving back makes the journey meaningful and fulfilling.

🎓 The Committed Teacher

Knowledge only becomes valuable when shared. The Buddhist concept of bodhichitta drives me to teach everything I learn.

Whether through writing, speaking, or personal mentoring, I believe wisdom multiplies when given away. Moreover, teaching helps me solidify my own understanding while contributing to others’ growth.

🧠 The Mensan

I had the opportunity to set up the Pakistani chapter of Mensa International and served as its founding chairperson.

One side effect of a high IQ is that I can see things from perspectives usually overlooked by most people. Over time, I’ve come to deeply value this ability.

At the same time, I’ve learned that intellectual rigor must go hand in hand with humility and compassion. True wisdom isn’t about knowing more—it’s about using what we know to uplift others.

💘 The Unabashed Romantic

I wholeheartedly embrace the full emotional spectrum of life—the highs, the lows, and everything in between.

Whether it’s the exhilaration of falling in love, the ache of heartbreak, or the quiet joy of a deep connection, I see these emotions not as weaknesses but as the essence of what makes us human.

Love, in all its forms, shapes how I experience the world. It influences my interactions with people, my appreciation for life, and my understanding of its beauty.

Passion drives me to seek meaningful connections and cherish the moments that make life profound. This romantic sensibility isn’t just about romance—it’s about celebrating the depth of feeling that binds us all together.

✍️ The Writer

This blog serves as my intellectual home, where I explore themes like faith, relationships, personal growth, and unconventional perspectives.

I write not as someone who has all the answers but as a fellow traveler trying to make sense of life’s complexities. Above all, I aim to create meaningful conversations through my words.

🎤 The Speaker

I have a lot to say, and I find it far easier to speak than to write. Words flow naturally when I’m talking, and being a former TV host has made me incredibly comfortable in front of the camera.

Whether it’s a thought, an idea, or a lesson I’ve learned, I often prefer to record a video and share it with the world. It’s immediate, personal, and allows me to connect with others in a way that feels authentic and unfiltered.

For me, speaking isn’t just about sharing—it’s about connecting. And if my words resonate with even one person, then the effort is worth it.

🚧 The Perpetual Work-in-Progress

Fragments of my past thinking are scattered across the internet, but I’m less concerned with compiling them than with continuing to grow.

The present moment always offers new opportunities for understanding, while the past remains useful mainly for its lessons.

🤝 Let’s Walk This Path Together

If any part of my journey resonates with you, I warmly invite you to join the conversation. Share your thoughts, challenge my perspectives, or simply say hello.

After all, we’re all both students and teachers in this life, and the most meaningful growth happens through genuine connection.

entry.title: About Me: Discovering Life Through Curiosity, Faith, and Connection
entry.summary: Key Points A curious life shaped by diverse experiences, faith, and learning. Exposure to international education and cultures fostering tolerance…
entry.content:
Key Points

  • A curious life shaped by diverse experiences, faith, and learning.
  • Exposure to international education and cultures fostering tolerance and growth.
  • Insights from a multifaceted career in engineering, entrepreneurship, broadcasting, and software development.
  • A focus on sharing lessons to inspire others and leave a legacy of wisdom and kindness.

A Curious Life: Wearing Many Hats

I wear many hats in life—broadcaster, personal development guide, entrepreneur, engineer, software developer, traveler, and lifelong learner. Some might call me a jack of all trades, but I see myself as someone endlessly curious. My interests grow every day, and I love exploring new ideas.

Life has been generous enough to offer countless opportunities, and I’ve worked hard to make the most of them. Each experience—whether success or failure—has contributed to who I am today.

A Life Guided by Faith

One constant in my life is my faith. I let God guide my decisions, big and small. Looking back, this has been one of the best choices I ever made. It gave me strength during tough times and gratitude during good ones.

Life threw its fair share of challenges my way, but those moments taught me valuable lessons. Now, in this later phase of life, I focus on undoing past mistakes and creating meaningful energy for the future.

Born in Pakistan, Shaped by International Education

I was born, raised, and have lived most of my life in Pakistan. But I’ve had the privilege of pursuing an international education and traveling extensively. These experiences opened my eyes to different cultures, perspectives, and ways of thinking.

Through these journeys, I became more tolerant of others’ views and learned to appreciate diversity in all its forms. This openness has stayed with me and continues to influence how I interact with the world.

A Multifaceted Journey: From Engineering to Broadcasting

My career path reflects my diverse interests. I’m an electrical engineer by education, an entrepreneur by profession, and a broadcaster by passion. Oh, and did I mention? I’m also a self-taught software developer. Running my own software business while hosting TV shows kept me busy for years—but it was worth every moment.

These roles may seem unrelated, but they all stem from my curiosity and desire to explore new horizons. Together, they’ve shaped who I am today.

Speaking to the Masses: A Transformative Experience

Becoming a TV celebrity opened doors I never expected. One of the most impactful was being invited as a public speaker. Universities, conferences, corporate meetings—you name it. I found myself addressing diverse audiences, sometimes more than a thousand people at a time.

Speaking to such varied groups taught me how to connect with people on a deeper level. It wasn’t just about sharing ideas—it was about listening, understanding, and adapting my message to resonate with different perspectives. This experience transformed the way I communicate and interact with others.

To read more about how public speaking changed me, check out my blog post: How Public Speaking Transformed My Perspective.

Sharing What I’ve Learned

Over the years, I’ve accumulated lessons—not just through books or formal education, but through real-life experiences. Both the highs and lows have humbly contributed to shaping who I am.

In recent years, I’ve felt a strong urge to share these lessons with others. Why? Because if even one person learns from my mistakes or finds inspiration in my journey, then sharing my story becomes worthwhile.

This website is where I pour out my thoughts. My blog covers everything under the sun—inspirations, reflections, questions, answers, and yes, loose ends. If something catches my interest, I write about it. Think of it as an open notebook filled with musings, discoveries, and insights.

A Boomer Reflecting on Life’s Purpose

As a boomer, I find myself reflecting more deeply these days. I’m no longer chasing material success or external validation. Instead, I want to leave behind a legacy of kindness, wisdom, and continuous learning .

I spend a lot of time reading and seeking information, which I try to turn into knowledge based on all else that I learn and know, with an objective, unbiased mind. There’s so much to explore, and this pursuit keeps me engaged and growing.

Looking Back, Moving Forward

Some of my earlier writings are scattered across the web. Occasionally, I think about gathering them into one place. But honestly, I believe the past should stay where it belongs—in the past. What matters now is moving forward, picking up the pieces, and continuing to grow.

This mindset keeps me grounded and focused on what truly matters: embracing the present and building a better future.

Join Me on This Journey

If any part of my story resonates with you, stick around. Explore my blog, leave a comment, or simply say hello. Your feedback means a lot to me. Together, we can learn, grow, and maybe even inspire each other along the way.

Thank you for taking the time to get to know me. Here’s to curiosity, connection, and the endless pursuit of growth. See you in the comments!

entry.title: Who Am I: A Journey of Growth and Self-Discovery
entry.summary: Key Points Discover how embracing challenges shapes personal growth. Learn why curiosity is the foundation of a meaningful life. Explore…
entry.content:
Key Points

  • Discover how embracing challenges shapes personal growth.
  • Learn why curiosity is the foundation of a meaningful life.
  • Explore the balance between celebrating diversity and honoring individuality.
  • Understand the role of family, education, and mentorship in shaping identity.
  • Uncover the power of storytelling and communication in connecting with others.

Embarking on a Self-Discovery Journey

I’m a seeker, constantly exploring life’s beauty and challenges. My identity has been shaped by curiosity, growth, and a deep commitment to my self-discovery journey . Every step of this journey has taught me something new, and I’m excited to share it with you.

The Journey of a Lifetime

Life is short, but how we live it truly matters. For me, it’s not just about existing—it’s about becoming the best version of myself. Over time, I’ve embraced various roles and experiences that have shaped who I am today.

For instance, I began as an electrical engineer. Later, I ventured into broadcasting, entrepreneurship, and public speaking. Each experience added a new layer to my identity. Challenges became stepping stones, pushing me closer to my goals. Growth often happens when we step outside our comfort zones.

Moreover, these transitions weren’t always easy. But they reminded me of an ancient Taoist principle: “The journey is the reward.” Every twist and turn brought clarity and resilience.

The Quest for Enlightenment in Your Self-Discovery Journey

My journey has taken me through engineering, art, science, and philosophy. Curiosity drives me. Whether it’s reading about spirituality, studying human behavior, or reflecting on life’s big questions, I’m always seeking knowledge.

This quest isn’t just about learning—it’s about finding purpose. As Socrates once said, “An unexamined life is not worth living.” Every book, person, and experience adds depth to my understanding of the world.

Additionally, this continuous learning feels like solving a puzzle. Each discovery brings me closer to clarity and peace. It’s fulfilling in ways I never imagined.

The Paradox of Identity

I believe in celebrating diversity while honoring individuality. On one hand, I see myself as part of the collective human experience. On the other hand, I cherish my unique identity.

This paradox defines my approach to life. I embrace different perspectives, cultures, and ideas. At the same time, I stay true to who I am.

In fact, this balance keeps me grounded and open-minded. It reminds me of a line from the Quran (49:13): “O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another.” We’re all connected, yet uniquely special.

Acknowledgments

No journey is traveled alone. My family has played a huge role in shaping who I am. They instilled in me a love for learning and the courage to dream big. Their support gave me the confidence to pursue opportunities that expanded my horizons.

Education has been another key asset. It opened doors to passions like broadcasting, public speaking, and personal development. These experiences have enriched my life in countless ways.

Moreover, their belief in me fueled my determination. Without them, I wouldn’t be where I am today.

My Interests

I’m passionate about communication, helping others, and personal growth. Broadcasting and public speaking allow me to connect with people from all walks of life. Sharing stories and ideas has the power to inspire change.

Whether it’s mentoring, offering guidance, or simply listening, I’ve found that even small gestures can create meaningful connections. Personal development and spirituality continue to guide me toward purpose and inner peace.

Truly, these interests are more than hobbies—they’re a way of life. Every action, no matter how small, contributes to the unfolding of greater understanding and harmony.

I Am a Bullshit Artist (But in a Good Way)

Some call me a “bullshit artist,” and I don’t mind. What they mean is that I have a talent for storytelling, conversation, and connecting with people.

Communication is my superpower. It lets me build bridges, share ideas, and inspire others. Instead of shying away from this label, I embrace it as a gift.

In fact, this skill has opened doors I never imagined. It’s helped me connect with people from diverse backgrounds and create meaningful relationships.

In Conclusion

Life is a journey, and it’s up to us to make the most of it. I strive to embrace knowledge, celebrate diversity, and focus on personal growth.

If my story inspires even one person to start their own self-discovery journey , I’ve succeeded. After all, we only get one life—let’s make it meaningful.

What resonates with you? Drop a comment—I’d love to hear your thoughts or just say hello!
